package fixture

import "strings"

// Ordinary Go that must not trip the rule. Each starts with an authorization verb and continues
// into something unrelated to permission; firing on these would get the gate waived everywhere.
func hasPrefix(s string) bool      { return strings.HasPrefix(s, "x") }
func canRetry(n int) bool          { return n < 3 }
func isReady() bool                { return true }
func validateName(s string) error  { return nil }
func checkSum(b []byte) int        { return len(b) }
